info.name: rental-engine: TfL Journey Planner
info.description:
TfL (Transport for London) API used by the rental-engine pipeline for commute enrichment.

Auth: No auth required for free tier. TFL_APP_KEY env var (optional) removes rate limits.
Base URL: https://api.tfl.gov.uk

Pipeline runs two parallel tracks per listing (tfl.py):
- Track A: postcodes.io -> lat/lon -> TfL StopPoint (nearest station + zone + walk minutes)
- Track B: TfL Journey Planner (postcode -> destination, multiple destinations in parallel)

Destinations (Wave 1 default): Canary Wharf (1000266) and Whitechapel.

Known issue (Wave 1 Agent C): Raw postcode origin to some destinations returns HTTP 300 Multiple Choices. Fix: resolve postcode to lat/lon via postcodes.io first, use lat,lon as the from parameter.

request.description:
Public transport journey from Dalston (E8 1DP) to Canary Wharf (NaPTAN icsId: 1000266). Pipeline takes the minimum duration across all returned journey options.

Note: 1000266 is the icsId for Canary Wharf DLR/Jubilee. Resolved via /StopPoint/Search at pipeline startup and cached per process (see resolve_destination_to_stopid in tfl.py).

response.name: E8 1DP to Canary Wharf - 3 options, fastest 36 mins

request.description: Cycle journey from Dalston (E8 1DP) to Canary Wharf. The pipeline runs this in parallel with the public transport call via enrich_commute_multi, storing result as cycle_canary_wharf in the listing.

item.name: Journey Planner - 300 disambiguation bug (Wave 1 Agent C)

request.description:
DOCUMENTS A BUG. Raw postcode origin ('E8 1DP') with NaPTAN destination (940GZZLUWHL = Whitechapel) returns HTTP 300 Multiple Choices. TfL cannot resolve the postcode to a unique origin.

This is the root cause of NULL commute_whitechapel in most listings (Wave 1 Agent C investigation).

Fix: resolve origin postcode to lat/lon via postcodes.io first, then use '51.5458,-0.0754' as the from parameter. See 'Journey Planner - lat/lon origin (fixed)' request.

response.name: E8 1DP to Whitechapel - HTTP 300 (disambiguation failure)
response.body: {"_http_status": 300, "_note": "HTTP 300 Multiple Choices. TfL Journey Planner cannot resolve 'E8 1DP' as origin when destination is a Whitechapel NaPTAN ID. Root cause (Wave 1 Agent C): raw postcode origin with a station NaPTAN ID destination triggers disambiguation. Fix: resolve postcode to lat,lon via postcodes.io first (51.5458,-0.0754), then use lat,lon string as origin. See tfl_journey_latlon_success example.", "_resolution": "Use lat,lon as origin: /Journey/JourneyResults/51.5458,-0.0754/to/{destination_id}"}

item.name: Journey Planner - lat/lon origin (Wave 1 Agent C fix)

request.description:
WORKING FIX for the 300 disambiguation issue. Use lat,lon string as origin instead of postcode. Coordinates for E8 1DP resolved via postcodes.io: 51.5458,-0.0754.

Result: 3 journey options, fastest 29 mins to Canary Wharf. The pipeline's enrich_commute_multi already follows this pattern via _postcode_to_latlon -> _nearest_station. The fix ensures the journey planner also receives lat/lon not raw postcode.
